否定 式 与 疑问 式 中 也 可 以 用 do/does:
口 They don’t have any children. (= They havent got any ‘children. )
i It’s a nice house, but it doesn’t have a garden. (= it hasn’t got a garden)
O Does Helen have a car? (= Has Helen got a car?)
口 What do you have in your bag? (= What have you got in your bag?)
